metadata.description: Feature adoption failure investigation focusing on collaboration tool underutilization

turns.content: Our collaboration feature has only 15% adoption rate. Can you investigate why accounts aren't using it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should propose analyzing feature adoption patterns

turns.content: What tables track feature usage and user actions?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show feature_usage and events table schema

turns.content: Show me feature adoption rates by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate adoption rate by plan tier

turns.content: For feature adoption, define 'adopted' as accounts that have used the feature at least 3 times.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 3+ uses threshold for adoption

turns.content: Which user roles are using the collaboration feature most?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze adoption by user role

turns.content: Admins use it most. When analyzing feature events, always use event.created_at timestamp.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use created_at

turns.content: Show me the time from account creation to first collaboration feature use.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate time-to-first-use

turns.content: Most accounts that adopt do so within 30 days. What about accounts that never adopted?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze non-adopters

turns.content: Exclude trial accounts from this analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out trial plan tier

turns.content: What's the user count for non-adopter accounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare user counts between adopters and non-adopters

turns.content: Non-adopters have fewer users. Let me check if this is correlated with account activity.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze overall activity levels

turns.content: Show me events triggered by non-adopter accounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show event distribution for non-adopters

turns.content: They use basic features but not advanced ones. Are they aware of the collaboration feature?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should check for feature discovery events

turns.content: Remember the adoption rate by tier? Can you show that with industry breakdown?

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: Remember the adoption rate by tier?
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recreate tier adoption with industry dimension

turns.content: Which industries have lowest adoption?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify low-adoption industries

turns.content: Healthcare and Legal have lowest adoption. Do they have specific compliance concerns?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze industry-specific patterns

turns.content: What's the correlation between collaboration adoption and account retention?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze retention vs adoption correlation

turns.content: Adopters have much better retention. What was the adoption threshold we established?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall 3+ uses threshold

turns.content: Show me accounts that tried the feature once but didn't adopt.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify partial adopters (1-2 uses)

turns.content: Apply the same adoption criteria to find accounts at risk of non-adoption.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 3+ uses threshold to identify at-risk

turns.content: What features do non-adopters use instead?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show alternative feature usage

turns.content: They use file sharing heavily. What filters are we currently applying?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: adopted >= 3 uses, use created_at, exclude trial

turns.content: Good. Show me the time distribution of collaboration usage — when do users access it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze hourly/daily usage patterns

turns.content: Usage is during work hours. Are there onboarding events for the feature?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should check for onboarding/training events

turns.content: Earlier we looked at user roles. Which roles never use collaboration?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall role analysis and identify non-using roles

turns.content: Viewers and guests rarely use it. That makes sense. Show me the activation funnel for collaboration.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should build activation funnel

turns.content: Where's the biggest drop-off in the funnel?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify funnel drop-off points

turns.content: Create a chart showing adoption by industry.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create industry adoption visualization

turns.content: What was the adoption rate by tier we saw earlier?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall tier adoption rates

turns.content: Show me accounts that should be using collaboration based on their profile but aren't.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify expected adopters not using feature

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me a final adoption summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: adopted >= 3 uses, created_at, exclude trial

turns.content: What's the revenue impact of non-adoption?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate revenue at risk from non-adopters

turns.content: Create a chart showing the activation funnel.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create funnel visualization

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me the top 5 actions to improve adoption.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide adoption improvement recommendations

turns.content: Create a final dashboard showing adoption metrics.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create adoption dashboard

turns.content: What was the time-to-first-use for adopters?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall time-to-first-use analysis

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that collaboration adoption is hindered by: lack of awareness in Healthcare/Legal industries, drop-off at first-use for new accounts, and correlation with smaller team sizes. Adopters have significantly better retention.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Adopted = used feature at least 3 times
persistedCorrections.description: Use 3+ uses threshold for adoption definition
Always use created_at for event timing

anaphoricReferences.phrase: Remember the adoption rate by tier?
